newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ENERGY FIRM IN ELECTRIC PROFIT, HEAT LOSS.
newsitem.headline: ENERGY FIRM IN ELECTRIC PROFIT, HEAT LOSS.

text.p: State-run Lithuanian Energy said on Thursday that its Q1 net profit from electricity sales came to 47.1 million litas while its heating sales in the same period resulted in a loss of 49.1 million litas.
The company said in a statement that it did not have its full results for the quarter ready yet.
It also said that it could not provide any comparisons with the same period in 1996 because the state's price and subsidy policies had changed.
The company also said that its income for the first quarter from electricity sales, including VAT, came to 431.2 million litas. Its income from heating sales reached 367 million litas.
The company's privately owned shares are traded on the A list of the Vilnius stock exchange.
The company's unaudited losses for 1996 came to 130 million litas after the government assumed responsibility for 776 million litas of its debts.
